title: ai4medicine challenges at TUM.AI Makeathon
summary: A repository of evaluation scripts used to score final submissions for a healthcare-focused hackathon (TUM.AI Makeathon), including a challenge on evaluating synthetic time-series data against real data. It imports SDV's timeseries metrics module (LSTMDetection) to score synthetic data quality.
